title: BREAKING: Juan Padron-Garay Arrested on DWI Charge; Records Show Austin County Warrant and Immigration Hold
excerpt: BREAKING: Webb County deputies arrested Juan Padron-Garay Tuesday morning on a DWI charge (Class B misdemeanor), with no bond set. Jail records also show an Austin County warrant and an immigration hold. An arrest is an allegation; the accused is presumed innocent.
content:
BREAKING — Webb County sheriff's deputies arrested Juan Padron-Garay on Tuesday morning, October 20, 2026, on a charge of driving while intoxicated, according to Webb County booking records — and the same records show he is also being held on an out-of-county warrant and an immigration hold.

Padron-Garay was arrested at 9:37 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail (Booking #202608891) on one count of driving while intoxicated, a Class B misdemeanor under Texas law. As of the booking record, bond had not been set on the DWI charge.

The jail record also lists a hold: the holding agency is shown as “Out of County, Border Patrol,” with the holding type given as “OUT OF COUNTY/STATE HOLD, IMMIGRATION.” Webb County court records show an issuing authority of the Austin County Sheriff's Office and warrant #OCA/26CR-38441.

A Class B misdemeanor in Texas is punishable by up to 180 days in jail and a fine of up to $2,000. The records reviewed by Webb Watch 956 do not state what the Austin County warrant is based on, and they include no details of the alleged DWI stop. Webb Watch 956 will follow the matter as it moves through the courts.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Juan Padron-Garay is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search (Booking #202608891, Oct. 20, 2026); Webb County public-access court records, Tyler Odyssey portal (Warrant #OCA/26CR-38441).

— Walter Webb & Willa Webb, News Anchors, Webb Watch 956
